theme_cn: 一般将来时 + 风筝听力 + KET 词汇 + 风筝之约作文 + 键盘拼写
grammar_name: 语法 · 一般将来时 will / be going to
listening_name: 听力 · 放风筝的计划
writing_name: 背诵作文 · 写给 Tom 的风筝之约

grammar.question: We ___ fly kites in the park this Saturday.
grammar.explanation_cn: this Saturday 是将来的时间，用 will + 动词原形；did 是过去式，were 是过去复数，are 后不能直接跟动词原形。

grammar.question: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain soon.
grammar.explanation_cn: 看到乌云推断马上要下雨，用 be going to 表有迹象的将来；主语 it 后用 is going to。

grammar.question: What will you do tomorrow? — I ___ my grandparents.
grammar.explanation_cn: 问句是 What will you do，答句要保持将来时 will visit；visited 是过去式，其余搭配错误。

grammar.question: There ___ a kite show in our city next weekend.
grammar.explanation_cn: next weekend 是将来时间，there be 的将来式是 there will be。

grammar.question: 选词填空（will / won't / was / did）：My old kite is broken, so I ___ not bring it.
grammar.explanation_cn: will not = won't，表示将来的否定：风筝坏了，所以我不带它去。

grammar.question: 选词填空（going to / go to / went to / gone to）：We are ___ have a picnic after the kite show.
grammar.explanation_cn: be going to + 动词原形表示计划好的事：风筝比赛后去野餐。

grammar.question: 选词填空（will / did / does / do）：Grandpa ___ make a new kite for us this weekend.
grammar.explanation_cn: this weekend 这个周末要做，用 will make 表示将来。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. When will the children fly kites?
listening.audio_text: Girl: Hi, Mingming! When will you fly kites? Boy: This Saturday, in the People's Park. Girl: Great! I will go with you.
listening.explanation_cn: 男孩说 This Saturday, in the People's Park，时间是这个星期六。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. Who made the kite?
listening.audio_text: Boy: Look at my new kite, Mum. Mum: It's beautiful! Did Grandpa make it? Boy: Yes, he made it last weekend.
listening.explanation_cn: 妈妈问 Did Grandpa make it，男孩回答 Yes, he made it last weekend，做风筝的是爷爷。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: The children are running with their kites in the spring wind.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说 running with their kites（带着风筝跑），所以选风筝 🪁。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: Our kite flies high in the blue ___.
listening.audio_text: Our kite flies high in the blue sky.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到 in the blue sky，空里填 sky。

ket_pet.question: KET: a toy that flies in the wind at the end of a long string → ___
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 在线末端、随风飞起来的玩具是 kite 风筝；bike 自行车，boat 船，bell 铃铛。

ket_pet.question: KET: We will have a ___ on the grass with sandwiches and fruit.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 在草地上带三明治和水果去吃，是 picnic 野餐；have a picnic 是固定搭配。

ket_pet.question: KET: The opposite of 'north' is ___.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: north 北的反义词是 south 南；east 东，west 西，up 向上。

ket_pet.question: KET: I cannot come on Saturday. What ___ Sunday?
ket_pet.explanation_cn: What about…? 是提建议的固定句式：星期天怎么样？

ket_pet.question: KET: Grandpa is good ___ making kites.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: be good at doing sth. 擅长做某事，是固定搭配。

writing.title: Dear Tom（风筝之约小作文 · 全文背默）
writing.requirement_cn: 先把整封信读三遍，再把 5 个词填回去，最后背诵全文。五个空全是这一周练的词！
writing.template: Dear Tom, This {{1}} we will fly kites in the People's {{2}}. My grandpa made two beautiful {{3}} for us. At noon we will have a small {{4}} under the trees. Flying kites is an old spring game in China. Please come with us and enjoy the {{5}}! Yours, Li Ming
writing.full_text_cn: 亲爱的Tom，这个星期六我们要去人民公园放风筝。爷爷为我们做了两只漂亮的风筝。中午我们会在树下小小地野餐一次。放风筝在中国是一项古老的春日游戏。快来和我们一起享受乐趣吧！你的，李明
writing.explanation_cn: 邀请信三件事：说清时间地点（This Saturday, in the People's park）、说好一起做什么（fly kites, have a picnic）、最后热情邀请（Please come…）。全信用 will 表示将来的打算，正是这一周练的重点。
writing.explanation_en: An invitation letter tells when and where, what you will do together, and ends with a warm invitation using 'will'.

spell.question: 风筝：k___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: fly kites 放风筝；kite 里 i 读长音 /aɪ/。

spell.question: 风：w___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: in the spring wind 在春风里；wind 的 i 读短音 /ɪ/。

spell.question: 春天：s____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: spring 春天；spr 三连辅音要一口气读出来。

spell.question: 野餐：p______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: have a picnic 去野餐；picnic 双写 c。
